orevault.node.disturbed_zone_unlock.name: Disturbed Zone Unlock
orevault.node.disturbed_zone_unlock.desc: Unlocks the Disturbed Zone block, allowing it to be crafted and placed inside the Vault.
orevault.node.vein_expansion.name: Vein Expansion
orevault.node.vein_expansion.desc: Increases the size of ore veins generated in newly explored Vault chunks.
orevault.node.vein_proliferation.name: Vein Proliferation
orevault.node.vein_proliferation.desc: Increases the number of ore veins generated per chunk.
orevault.node.deep_veins.name: Deep Veins
orevault.node.deep_veins.desc: Shifts ore generation weighting toward lower Y levels.
orevault.node.twin_veins.name: Twin Veins
orevault.node.twin_veins.desc: Chance that a fully mined vein spawns a second identical vein nearby.
orevault.node.vault_echo.name: Vault Echo
orevault.node.vault_echo.desc: A Resonance burst is awarded when a vein is fully mined.
orevault.node.common_ore_boost.name: Common Ore Boost
orevault.node.common_ore_boost.desc: Increases spawn rates of common ores.
orevault.node.uncommon_ore_boost.name: Uncommon Ore Boost
orevault.node.uncommon_ore_boost.desc: Increases spawn rates of uncommon ores.
orevault.node.rare_ore_boost.name: Rare Ore Boost
orevault.node.rare_ore_boost.desc: Increases spawn rates of rare ores.
orevault.node.ancient_traces.name: Ancient Traces
orevault.node.ancient_traces.desc: Ancient debris generates at low Y levels in the Vault.
orevault.node.gravel_purge.name: Gravel Purge
orevault.node.gravel_purge.desc: No gravel or clay generates in newly explored chunks.
orevault.node.stone_reduction.name: Stone Reduction
orevault.node.stone_reduction.desc: Replaces a portion of filler stone with ore-bearing rock.
orevault.node.geode_clusters.name: Geode Clusters
orevault.node.geode_clusters.desc: Amethyst geodes generate inside the Vault at higher frequency.
orevault.node.ore_sense.name: Ore Sense
orevault.node.ore_sense.desc: Passive Fortune effect on all ore mining inside the Vault.
orevault.node.ore_doubling.name: Ore Doubling
orevault.node.ore_doubling.desc: Ore drops are multiplied (dust, then processed outputs with Mekanism).
orevault.node.runic_attunement.name: Runic Attunement
orevault.node.runic_attunement.desc: Chance that ore drops are attuned for magic processing.
orevault.node.smelters_intuition.name: Smelter's Intuition
orevault.node.smelters_intuition.desc: Chance that ore blocks drop the already-smelted result.
orevault.node.stone_memory.name: Stone Memory
orevault.node.stone_memory.desc: Stone and deepslate drop XP and additional benefits.
orevault.node.ancient_knowledge.name: Ancient Knowledge
orevault.node.ancient_knowledge.desc: Ore blocks drop bonus XP orbs.
orevault.node.efficient_miner.name: Efficient Miner
orevault.node.efficient_miner.desc: Reduces hunger drain inside the Vault.
orevault.node.resonance_magnetism.name: Resonance Magnetism
orevault.node.resonance_magnetism.desc: Resonance orbs are attracted from greater distances.
orevault.node.hoarders_instinct.name: Hoarder's Instinct
orevault.node.hoarders_instinct.desc: Orbs no longer float to you; manual collection grants 2x Resonance.
orevault.node.automated_extraction.name: Automated Extraction
orevault.node.automated_extraction.desc: Machines breaking ores in ticket-loaded chunks award Resonance.
orevault.node.vault_presence.name: Vault Presence
orevault.node.vault_presence.desc: Increases the team's simultaneous chunk-loading tickets.
orevault.node.vault_expansion.name: Vault Expansion
orevault.node.vault_expansion.desc: Expands the Vault to Y=-64..320 with an ultra-deep layer. Requires a reset.
orevault.node.ultimine_expansion.name: Ultimine Expansion
orevault.node.ultimine_expansion.desc: Increases the maximum block count of FTB Ultimine in the Vault.
orevault.node.ultimine_safety.name: Ultimine Safety
orevault.node.ultimine_safety.desc: Reduces Volatile Veins disappearance chance during Ultimine.
orevault.node.volatile_veins.name: Volatile Veins
orevault.node.volatile_veins.desc: +25% vein size, but veins may vanish when mined. Pity-protected.
orevault.node.ultimine_gambit.name: Ultimine Gambit
orevault.node.ultimine_gambit.desc: Riskier Ultimine disappearance rolls; safe operations grant +20% Resonance.
orevault.node.greedy_seams.name: Greedy Seams
orevault.node.stone_curse.name: Stone Curse
orevault.node.stone_curse.desc: 3x Stone Memory XP, but stone drops nothing.
orevault.node.vault_fever.name: Vault Fever
orevault.node.vault_fever.desc: Permanent Haste II in the Vault, but hunger drains faster.
orevault.node.tithe.name: Tithe
orevault.node.tithe.desc: 25% of ores are consumed for 1.75x Resonance. Does not affect bonus drops from Stone Memory or other secondary sources.
orevault.node.abundance.name: Abundance
orevault.node.abundance.desc: Many small deposits scattered throughout chunks.
orevault.node.motherlode.name: Motherlode
orevault.node.motherlode.desc: Rare but enormous deposits; vein count halved.
orevault.node.vaults_blessing.name: Vault's Blessing
orevault.node.vaults_blessing.desc: Potion effects last 50% longer while inside the Vault.
orevault.node.vaults_purity.name: Vault's Purity
orevault.node.vaults_purity.desc: No potion effects inside the Vault. Pure skill.
orevault.node.zone_frequency.name: Zone Frequency
orevault.node.zone_frequency.desc: Increases mob spawn frequency within Disturbed Zones.
orevault.node.zone_pack_size.name: Zone Pack Size
orevault.node.zone_pack_size.desc: Increases the number of mobs per spawn attempt.
orevault.node.zone_radius.name: Zone Radius
orevault.node.zone_radius.desc: Increases the radius of each Disturbed Zone block's spawn area.
orevault.node.mob_diversity.name: Mob Diversity
orevault.node.mob_diversity.desc: Unlocks additional mob categories in Disturbed Zones.
orevault.node.reapers_claim.name: Reaper's Claim
orevault.node.corrupted_veins.name: Corrupted Veins
orevault.node.corrupted_veins.desc: Zone mobs have a chance to drop raw ore.
orevault.node.plunderers_share.name: Plunderer's Share
orevault.node.animus_amplifier.name: Animus Amplifier
orevault.node.animus_amplifier.desc: Increases Animus dropped per mob kill.
orevault.node.soul_harvest.name: Soul Harvest
orevault.node.soul_harvest.desc: Zone mobs occasionally drop a Soul Harvest item.
